settings.line_2: Fastest way to reach the team

settings.heading: Contact Information
settings.text: Questions about a formula, an order, or your routine? Reach the Prüv team directly — no bots, no ticket queues. We read and answer every message ourselves.
settings.map_title: Prüv head office location on Google Maps

settings.question: How can I track my order?
settings.answer: The moment your order ships you will get an email and an SMS with a live tracking link. You can also check status any time under Account → Orders. Metros usually receive their parcel in 2–4 working days; the rest of India in 4–7.

settings.question: Do you ship across India?
settings.answer: Yes — every serviceable PIN code in India, through our courier partners. Orders above ₹699 ship free; below that a flat ₹49 applies at checkout.

settings.question: Can I change or cancel my order after placing it?
settings.answer: If it has not been packed yet, email hello@pruv.in with your order number and we will amend or cancel it. Once it is handed to the courier we cannot recall it — but you can refuse delivery and we will refund you in full.

settings.question: Do you ship internationally?
settings.answer: Not yet. We are working on it. Join the newsletter and you will be the first to know when we open up shipping outside India.

settings.question: Are Prüv products suitable for hard water?
settings.answer: That is exactly what they are built for. Every formula is tested against hard water at Indian TDS levels, so it lathers, rinses clean and performs without leaving the mineral film that flattens hair and dulls colour.

settings.question: Are your formulas sulphate and paraben free?
settings.answer: Yes. No SLS, no SLES, no parabens and no added mineral oil. We use gentler surfactant systems that clean thoroughly without stripping the scalp barrier.

settings.question: Are they safe for colour-treated or keratin-treated hair?
settings.answer: Yes. Our cleansers are pH-balanced and colour-safe, so they will not accelerate fade or disturb a keratin treatment.

settings.question: How long before I see results?
settings.answer: Texture and manageability usually shift within 2–3 washes. Deeper concerns — fall, flaking, breakage — follow the hair's own cycle, so give it 8–12 weeks of consistent use before you judge.

settings.question: Do you test on animals?
settings.answer: Never. Prüv is 100% cruelty-free. Every formula is validated through human patch testing and in-vitro methods.

settings.question: What is your return policy?
settings.answer: Unopened products can be returned within 14 days of delivery for a full refund. Email hello@pruv.in with your order number and we will arrange a pickup.

settings.question: My product arrived damaged. What now?
settings.answer: Send a photo of the parcel and the product to hello@pruv.in within 48 hours of delivery. We will ship a replacement straight away — no return needed.

settings.question: How do I choose the right routine for my hair?
settings.answer: Tell us your water type, scalp condition and main concern at hello@pruv.in and we will build you a routine. It is free, and there is no obligation to buy anything.

settings.question: Where can I buy Prüv offline?
settings.answer: Prüv is direct-to-consumer for now — here and on select marketplaces. Retail partnerships are in progress; reach out at partners@pruv.in.
